paite: Ka lungtang thil hoih in adimlet a, kumpipa tungtang thu a ka laphuah ka gen ding hi; ka lei laigelh siamtak laigelhna ahi.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, Shoshannim Sak Ding; Korah Tate La, Maskil, Itna La / Kumpipa Zineihna La

paite: Mihing tate sang in na mel ahoihzaw a; hehpihna in na muk akinuh hi; huaiziak in Pathian in tangtawn a ding in ahon vualzawl ahi.
Aw, mihat, na kawng ah namsau vom in, na thupina leh na kilawmna toh.
Thutak leh thunuailutna leh diktatna ziak in na kilawmna silh in lamzangtak in sakol tung a tuang in pai zel in; huchi in na khut taklam in thil mulkimhuaite ahon hilh ding ahi.
Na thal azum a; michih na nuai ah apuk zel uh, kumpipa melmate lungtang ah atal hi.
Pathian aw, na laltutphah tangtawn in a-om ding ahi, khentuam neihlouhna lalchiang na gam lalchiang ahi.
Diktatna na deih a, gilou-salou na hua hi, huaiziak in, Pathian, na Pathian in, na lawmte sang in nakpi in nopna thau ahon nilhta hi.
Na puansilh tengteng murrah gimte, aloe gimte, sing gimte anam vungvung a; saiha a bawl kumpipa' inn a kaihging chi tuamtuam ging hong pawtte'n ahon hihnuam ahi.
Na numei hoihte lak ah kumpipate tanute apang ua; na taklam ah Ophir dangka-eng a kizem in kumpinu adingh hi.
Ka tanu aw, ngaikhia inla, ngaihtuah inla, bildoh in; na mite leh na pa inn a mite mangngilh in.
Huchi in kumpipa'n na melhoih adeih ding hi, amah i TOUPA ahi ngal a; amah bia in.
Tura tanu thilpiak tawi in huai ah a-om ding a; mi lak a hausate ngei in na deihsakna angen ding uhi.
Kumpipa insung a kumpipa tanu athupi zou hial a, apuansilh dangka-eng a zep kilawm ahi.
Puankhui kilawm silh in kumpipa kiang ah api ding ua, amah zui alawm nungakte na kiang ah api ding uh.
Kipak leh nuam in api ding ua, kumpipa' inn ah alut ding uh.
Na pate sik in na tate a-om ding ua; leitung tengteng ah milian in amaute na bawl ding.
Na min suan tengteng ah theihgige ding in ka bawl ding; huaiziak in michih in tangtawn tangtawn in kipahthu ahon hilh ding uh.
